title: Quick Cataract Test
summary: Visual puzzles and cataract-awareness questions in one quick challenge.

landing.intro:
10 quick vision questions.
Can you spot the subtle clues?

about.body:
This ten-question challenge combines five on-screen visual puzzles with five general-awareness questions about cataracts. It measures answers to this quiz, not eyesight, lens health or the likelihood of a cataract.

Screen size, brightness, contrast, eyesight, corrective lenses, fatigue and device settings can all affect performance. Discuss persistent blurry or hazy vision, glare, halos around lights, difficulty seeing at night or faded colors with a qualified eye-care professional. These symptoms can also have other causes.

steps: Complete five detail, pattern and visual-memory challenges.
Answer five questions about cataracts and when to seek help.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a visual-acuity test, eye examination, medical screening tool or diagnosis. It cannot confirm or rule out a cataract or any other eye condition. Seek immediate medical care for sudden vision loss, severe eye pain or a sudden major change in vision. Do not wait for a quiz result.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked and your cataract challenge score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Top-Scoring Observer
profile-1.copy: You answered nine or ten questions correctly. That is an excellent quiz score, not a measure of your eyesight or a medical finding.

profile-2.title: The Focused Observer
profile-2.copy: You answered eight questions correctly and reached the 80% target. You can unlock the review to see the correct answers to the two you missed. This score does not assess eye health.

profile-3.title: The Detail Spotter
profile-3.copy: You answered six or seven questions correctly. You can unlock the review to revisit the ones you missed. A screen quiz cannot assess the health of your eyes or their lenses.

profile-4.title: Room to Practice
profile-4.copy: You answered four or five questions correctly. Display settings and everyday factors can affect performance, but this score cannot explain why an answer was missed or indicate an eye condition.

profile-5.title: Another Chance to Explore
profile-5.copy: You answered fewer than four questions correctly this time. You can unlock the review to revisit the questions you missed. This result cannot confirm or rule out a cataract.

score.passed: You reached the quiz target of 80%!
score.disclaimer: This quiz score cannot diagnose or rule out a cataract. Seek qualified eye-care advice for persistent or worsening vision changes. Sudden vision loss, severe eye pain or a sudden major vision change needs immediate medical care.

cataract-q1.question: Which letter is in the exact middle of the grid?

visual.ariaLabel: A three by three letter grid: A P D, K F M, S T V

cataract-q2.question: Which code matches the reference exactly?

cataract-q3.question: Which symbol completes the alternating sequence?

visual.ariaLabel: Diamond, circle, diamond, circle, diamond, unknown

study.title: Remember the order of the five symbols
study.instruction: Read across each row from left to right, starting at the top. The symbols will disappear automatically.

cataract-q5.question: Counting from the left, which position contains the outlined circle?

visual.ariaLabel: Seven circles from left to right: filled, filled, filled, filled, outlined, filled, filled

answers.a2: A cloudy area in the eye's natural lens
answers.a3: A problem limited to the tear duct

cataract-q7.question: Which group contains common cataract symptoms?

answers.a1: Itchy skin and a sore throat
answers.a3: Blurry or hazy vision, glare and halos around lights
answers.a4: A stiff neck and aching shoulders

cataract-q8.question: How can an eye-care professional check for cataracts?

answers.a4: As part of a comprehensive dilated eye examination

cataract-q9.question: What is the safest response to sudden vision loss, severe eye pain or a sudden major change in vision?

answers.a2: Wait several months without mentioning it
answers.a3: Change screen brightness and assume it is fixed
answers.a4: Rely only on an online quiz

cataract-q10.question: What can your score on this online challenge tell you?

answers.a1: Whether your eyes' natural lenses are healthy
answers.a2: Only how you performed on these ten questions
answers.a4: Whether you can rule out a cataract
